## RYANAIR ANNOUNCES RECORD WROCŁAW WINTER SCHEDULE


**9 AIRCRAFT (2 NEW), 35% GROWTH (1.3M SEATS) & 4 NEW ROUTES**


Ryanair, Europe and Poland’s No.1 airline, today (16 Sept.) announced its record Winter ‘26 schedule for Wrocław, with 9 aircraft based (+2 vs W25), representing a US$900m investment in Lower Silesia. This record Winter schedule will deliver 1.3m seats (+330k additional / +35% growth), 4 exciting new routes to Madrid, Marrakesh, Tirana and Turin, as well as increased frequencies on 15 existing routes – supporting over 2,500 jobs.


**Ryanair’s Wrocław W26 schedule will deliver:**


- 9 based aircraft (+2 vs W25 – US$900m investment)
- 43 routes, incl. 4 new routes to Madrid, Marrakesh, Tirana and Turin
- Increased capacity on 15 existing routes – including Dublin, London, Malta and Palermo.
- 1.3m Winter ‘26 seats (+330k / +35% growth vs. W25)
- Over 3m passengers p.a.


To celebrate Ryanair’s record Winter ‘26 schedule in Wrocław, Ryanair has launched a limited-time seat sale with fares available from PLN 119, only at Ryanair.com and the Ryanair app.


**Ryanair’s Chief Commercial Officer, Jason McGuinness, said:**


*“We are delighted to announce Ryanair’s record Winter ’26 schedule for Wrocław, with 2 additional based aircraft, bringing our total Wroclaw fleet to 9 aircraft – representing a US$900m total investment in Lower Silesia. This major investment will deliver over 1.3m seats this Winter (+330k additional / +35% growth) and 43 routes, including 4 exciting new routes to Madrid, Marrakesh, Tirana and Turin, giving customers in Wroclaw even more choice at Europe’s lowest fares.*


*Ryanair’s 9 based aircraft and US$900m investment in Wroclaw demonstrates our continued commitment to growing Poland’s regional connectivity. This Winter, Wroclaw will benefit from +330k additional seats, 4 new routes and increased frequencies on 15 routes with Europe and Poland’s biggest airline, driving inbound tourism to Lower Silesia delivering even more year-round international connectivity at Europe’s lowest fares.*


*Today’s announcement caps off a record year of Ryanair investment and growth in Poland, with 52 based aircraft (US$5.2bn investment), more than 26m seats (+24% growth) and 361 routes including 49 routes.*


*To celebrate Ryanair’s biggest ever schedule and 4 new routes at Wroclaw this Winter, we’ve launched a 3-day seat sale with fares from just PLN 119 available only at Ryanair.com and the Ryanair app.”*


**Karol Przywara, CEO of Wrocław Airport, added:**


*“Wrocław Airport is posting record results and, despite the challenging situation in the aviation market—related, among other things, to fuel prices, which airlines in particular are grappling with—it continues to grow at a double-digit rate. We are pleased that Wrocław remains one of the most important destinations on Ryanair’s European network. This is evidenced not only by the airline’s extensive route network and large fleet, but also by the consistent expansion of its maintenance center operations. “Ryanair is a very important partner in the development of our airport, and we are already working on further joint projects and investments that will strengthen Wrocław’s position on Europe’s aviation map.”*
